messages:
nina: hitting a weird parity bug in the TS starter kit when using json_mode + function-calling. Repro on latest canary. Request body on retry loses the function schema objects and becomes an array of names, server returns 400 'function definition missing params'. cc @oz @ben

oz: can you paste a minimal repro/request dump?

nina: yes. Initial request (works):
```
{
  \"input\": \"run analysis\",
  \"functions\": [
    { \"name\": \"search\", \"params\": { \"q\": { \"type\": \"string\" }}},
    { \"name\": \"summarize\", \"params\": { \"text\": { \"type\": \"string\" }}}
  ]
}
```
On auth-refresh retry, outgoing body becomes: 
```
{
  \"input\": \"run analysis\",
  \"functions\": [\"search\", \"summarize\"]
}
```
Server rejects it.

ben: I think I saw this pattern before: our TS SDK's request cache for retry stores a serialized version of headers/body and then reconstructs it for the retry. Somewhere along the path we run a helper that "normalizeFunctions" to reduce payload size by replacing full defs with names for telemetry; that helper was accidentally applied to the cached request on retry.

nina: aha. That explains the mismatch. The helper is meant only for telemetry/transit but ended up mutating the request object in place.

oz: Two fixes: 1) quick patch - deep-clone cached request before any normalization on retry path, 2) longer-term - change normalizeFunctions to return a non-mutating copy and ensure the SDK never mutates the original request object stored in cache. Also add a unit test for function-calling parity across auth refresh.

ben: I'll open a small PR with the no-mutating change and test. For immediate customer mitigation, instruct them to set env var `SDK_DISABLE_FUNCTION_NORMALIZATION=true` in starter kit or pin SDK to previous patch.

devrel-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4525 for TS SDK function normalization causing retry body mutation. Linked to issue tracker.

nina: also add a line to starter-kit troubleshooting: "If function-calling fails with missing params after a retry, check for function normalization / serialization in retries."

oz: One more ask: add an e2e that simulates auth refresh during a function-calling request and verifies server receives full function defs on retry. This should be part of sdk-canary smoke.

ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/621 (draft)  non-mutating normalize + tests.

nina: thanks all. assigning: ben (PR + tests), oz (release note), devrel-bot (attach e2e to canary job). Closing when merged.
